sentences.text: Bernard Sanders -LRB- born September 8 , 1941 -RRB- is an American politician who has been the junior United States Senator from Vermont since 2007 .	Vermont	Vermont	junior	Seniority in the United States Senate	United States Senator	United States Senate
Sanders is the longest serving independent in U.S. congressional history .	independent	independent politician

Since his election to the House of Representatives in 1991 , he has caucused with the Democratic Party , which has entitled him to congressional committee assignments and at times given Democrats a majority .	Democratic	Democratic Party (United States)	House of Representatives	United States House of Representatives	Democratic Party	Democratic Party (United States)	congressional committee	congressional committee

Sanders became the ranking minority member on the Senate Budget Committee in January 2015 ; he had previously been chair of the Senate Veterans ' Affairs Committee for two years .	ranking minority member	ranking minority member	Senate Budget Committee	Senate Budget Committee

Since January 2017 , he has been Chair of the Senate Democratic Outreach Committee .	Democratic	Democratic Party (United States)	Senate Democratic Outreach Committee	United States Senate Democratic Steering and Outreach Committee

Sanders 's campaign against Hillary Clinton for the party 's 2016 U.S. presidential nomination raised more money in small , individual contributions than any other in American history , and helped him rise to international recognition .	Hillary Clinton	Hillary Clinton

A self-described democratic socialist , Sanders is pro-labor and emphasizes reversing economic inequality .	democratic socialist	Democratic socialism	pro-labor	pro-labor	economic inequality	economic inequality

Many scholars consider his views to be more in line with social democracy and New Deal-era American progressivism than democratic socialism .	social democracy	social democracy	New Deal	New Deal	American progressivism	Progressivism in the United States

Sanders was born and raised in the Brooklyn borough of New York City and graduated from the University of Chicago in 1964 .	Brooklyn	Brooklyn	New York City	New York City	New York	New York (state)	University of Chicago	University of Chicago

While a student he was an active protest organizer for the Congress of Racial Equality and the Student Nonviolent Coordinating Committee during the Civil Rights Movement .	Congress of Racial Equality	Congress of Racial Equality	Student Nonviolent Coordinating Committee	Student Nonviolent Coordinating Committee	Civil Rights Movement	Civil Rights Movement

After settling in Vermont in 1968 , Sanders ran unsuccessful third-party campaigns for governor and U.S. senator in the early to mid-1970s .	Vermont	Vermont	third-party	third party (United States)	governor	Governor of Vermont	U.S. senator	List of United States Senators from Vermont

As an independent , he was elected mayor of Burlington -- Vermont 's most populous city of 42,417 in 2010 -- in 1981 , by a margin of ten votes .	Vermont	Vermont	independent	independent politician	Burlington	Burlington, Vermont
He went on to be reelected as mayor three times .	reelected	United States Senate election in Vermont, 2012

In 1990 , he was elected to represent Vermont 's at-large congressional district in the U.S. House of Representatives , where he co-founded the Congressional Progressive Caucus in 1991 .	Vermont	Vermont	House of Representatives	United States House of Representatives	U.S. House of Representatives	U.S. House of Representatives	Congressional Progressive Caucus	Congressional Progressive Caucus
He served as a congressman for 16 years before being elected to the U.S. Senate in 2006 .	elected to the U.S. Senate in 2006	United States Senate election in Vermont, 2006
In 2012 , he was reelected with 71 % of the popular vote .	reelected	United States Senate election in Vermont, 2012
Polls indicate that he is among the senators most popular with their constituents , ranking third in 2014 and first in both 2015 and 2016 .

Sanders rose to national prominence following his 2010 filibuster against the Middle Class Tax Relief Act of 2010 , which extended the Bush tax cuts that favored the wealthiest Americans .	filibuster	filibuster	Middle Class Tax Relief Act of 2010	Middle Class Tax Relief Act of 2010	Bush tax cuts	Bush tax cuts

He has built a reputation as a leading progressive voice on issues such as campaign finance reform , corporate welfare , global warming , income inequality , LGBT rights , parental leave , and universal healthcare .	progressive	Progressivism in the United States	campaign finance reform	Campaign finance reform in the United States	corporate welfare	corporate welfare	global warming	global warming	income inequality	Income inequality in the United States	LGBT rights	LGBT rights in the United States	parental leave	parental leave	universal healthcare	universal healthcare

Sanders has long been critical of U.S. foreign policy and was an early and outspoken opponent of the Iraq War , the First Gulf War , and U.S. support for the Contras in Nicaragua .	U.S. foreign policy	U.S. foreign policy	Iraq War	Iraq War	First Gulf War	First Gulf War	Contras	Contras	Nicaragua	Nicaragua

He is also outspoken on civil liberties and civil rights , particularly criticizing racial discrimination in the criminal justice system as well as advocating for privacy rights against mass surveillance policies such as the USA PATRIOT Act and the NSA surveillance programs .	civil liberties	civil liberties	civil rights	civil rights	racial discrimination in the criminal justice system	Race and crime in the United States	privacy rights	Privacy	mass surveillance	Mass surveillance in the United States	USA PATRIOT Act	Patriot Act	NSA surveillance programs	Global surveillance disclosures (2013–present)

Sanders announced his campaign for the Democratic presidential nomination on April 30 , 2015 .	Democratic	Democratic Party (United States)	his campaign	Bernie Sanders presidential campaign, 2016	Democratic presidential nomination	2016 Democratic National Convention

Initially considered a long shot , Sanders won 23 primaries and caucuses and approximately 43 % of pledged delegates to Clinton 's 55 % .	primaries and caucuses	Democratic Party presidential primaries, 2016

His campaign was noted for the enthusiasm of its supporters , as well as his rejection of large donations from corporations , the financial industry , and any associated Super PAC .	Super PAC	Super PAC

On July 12 , 2016 , Sanders formally endorsed Clinton against her Republican general election opponent Donald Trump , while urging his supporters to continue the `` political revolution '' his campaign had begun .	his campaign	Bernie Sanders presidential campaign, 2016	Republican	Republican Party (United States)	Donald Trump	Donald Trump

In November 2016 , Sanders 's book Our Revolution : A Future to Believe In was released ; upon its release , it was on The New York Times best-seller list at number 3 .	New York	New York (state)	Our Revolution	Our Revolution

In 2016 Sanders formed a political organization , Our Revolution , to educate voters about issues , get people involved in the political process , and work to organize and elect progressive candidates .	progressive	Progressivism in the United States	Our Revolution	Our Revolution
In February 2017 , Sanders began webcasting The Bernie Sanders Show on Facebook .	Facebook	Facebook
